warnings: Pile length conflict on the same sheet: both footing sections print 'เข็มคอนกรีตหกเหลี่ยมกลวง ø 0.15x5.00ม' (and F3 on S-07 too — three callouts), while the ข้อกำหนดเสาเข็ม note says 'เข็มคอนกรีต ø 0.15x6.00ม ตามรูปแบบกำหนด'. length_m = 5.00 (the member callouts, three agreeing, win over the general note); the note is kept verbatim in pile.alternate_printed_as and the footings are flagged.
Footing mats are printed by spacing ('ø12มม @0.15ม#', two-way) with no bar count, so main_bar carries spacing_mm and no count. Ø = RB (section 0.6); no steel grade is printed anywhere in the set.
C1 has two sections, recorded as two entries with level (section 8): 0.30x0.30 from the pedestal (ตอม่อ) to the ground floor, 0.25x0.25 from the ground floor to the roof.
Footing depth: 1.20 from ระดับดินเดิม down to the top of the footing (kept in ground_reference).
